profile.headline: Remote Software Engineer | Allstate | Ex Discover Financial Services | US citizen authorized to work without sponsorship
profile.summary:
Full Stack Software Engineer - enterprise experience with AWS, microservices, event driven systems, batch processing, ETL, APIs, UIs, MVC, user interfaces, databases, data pipelines, data warehouses, and test driven development. I am personable, articulate, and have experience working directly with stakeholders to define project requirements, MVPs, and timeline estimates. I've built scalable enterprise projects that handle hundreds of thousands of requests daily. Proficient in team and independent work.

Programming Languages: Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, Groovy

Frameworks: React, Spring Boot, Nest.js, Express.js, Jest, Jasmine, JUnit, Mockito, FreeMarker templates

Technologies: Talend, Node.js, AWS, GIT, MySQL, NoSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Jenkins, Gradle, NPM, OAuth, Oracle APEX

System Design: Event driven systems, Microservices, Model-view-controller, Batch processing, ETL, Orchestrators, Data Persistence

Other Skills: PCF, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, SonarQube, Nexus, JWT, Oracle, Autonomous Data Warehouse, Data Warehouse, MariaDB, NetSuite, ERP, JSON, SOAP, BitBucket, Bamboo, GUI, UI, User Interace, Graphical User Interface

positions.title: Senior Associate Application Engineer (Full Stack)
positions.description:
Created Java Spring Boot microservices to migrate Discover’s acquisitions system onto Pivotal Cloud Foundry. Decouple and rewrite features from legacy monolithic systems. Aggregate REST APIs and MariaDB databases on AWS RDS. Utilize RabbitMQ messaging services to consume and publish events from other development teams. 

Front-end development on Discover’s pre-approval page, using MVC architecture with JavaScript, Freemarker 
Templates, Java, Spring Boot, HTML, CSS. Send form data with asynchronous REST calls. Optimize pages for mobile view. 

Agile and test driven development with SonarQube, JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine, and Groovy testing frameworks to design unit tests, integration tests, contract tests. Continuous integration and continuous deployment using Jenkins and Nexus. 

Monitor production systems with AppDynamics and Kibana logs to check error rates and historical error occurrences.

Internship - Web development using React, Nodejs, AWS RDS, and Elastic Beanstalk to create campus websites displaying NIU student data, and backend REST APIs with Express.js and MySQL databases.
